server.title: SYMONE documentation
server.description: Search and read SYMONE documentation: service, prices, public API, MCP servers, sandbox, limits.

serverInfo.name: symone-docs
serverInfo.instructions: Read-only documentation of SYMONE (long-distance motorcycle transport in France) and of its public API and MCP servers. Call search_docs with a question or keywords, then fetch_doc with the returned path to read the whole document. To search real trips, use the product MCP server at https://symone.fr/mcp.
